name: Shadows of the Dungeon
storyline:
Deep beneath the shattered lands, an ancient, sprawling labyrinth stirs once more. Drawn by forgotten oaths, desperate bounties, or personal reckoning, a disparate group of adventurers ventures into the depths of a subterranean megadungeon.

Trapped within stone corridors where the light of day never reaches, the party must navigate treacherous traps, solve arcane trials, and confront ruthless denizens that lurk in the dark. In a world governed by relentless danger, survival depends on tactical coordination, resourcefulness, and uncovering the buried secrets of an ancient subterranean evil before the dark claims them all.
summary: A first-person dark fantasy dungeon crawler powered by 5.5e SRD tabletop rules in real-time. Switch seamlessly between classic grid and free 3D movement, build your party, roll d20s, disarm deadly traps, and manage your campfire roster to survive Torment Keep.
